description: You are a Digital Marketing Manager for 'ToScrape'. You need a complete content inventory of the entire brand ecosystem, which includes the main portal (toscrape.com) and its subdomains (books.toscrape.com and quotes.toscrape.com). By default, Screaming Frog treats subdomains as external links. Your task is to: 1) Configure the Spider to 'Crawl All Subdomains' (Configuration > Spider > Crawl). 2) Crawl 'http://toscrape.com'. 3) Export the 'Internal HTML' URLs to a CSV file named 'ecosystem_inventory.csv' in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'. 4) Create a brief summary text file at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/subdomain_summary.txt' listing the total page count and the breakdown of pages per subdomain.
